notes: Agent environment, not acceptance. Periodicity: full renders of Witness-Overlay-Render, framemd5 per frame (yuva444p12le); the first frame from which every frame equals the one a 1.2 s cycle later up to the exit. Parity: the worker's short plan (intro 4.8 s, one 1.2 s cycle repeated, the real last 0.6 s) against a full render of the same timeline (tools/render-bench/circulated_bench.py parity, template witness). Before the font gate, pages that measured the tag and title before the fonts loaded cached the fallback widths, so every other frame differed between two renders; WitnessRender now renders nothing until fontsReady and holds the capture with delayRender. Case: the bench's 30s-1080p30-vertical-witness through make_circulated (local FFmpeg 6.1, not the image's 8.0.1); timing is not judged here. Widths: HarfBuzz shaping of the template fonts (Rubik Bold, Readex Pro SemiBold), title scale = box / width, title_overflow below 0.7. Synthetic clips and neutral sample text only. The CI bench in the render image repeats the parity and the case.
